transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Salieri! I’ve been away for two weeks on the Emperor’s business, trusting you to keep the rehearsals on schedule! The singers don’t know their entrances, the second violin parts are missing entirely, and someone has rewritten my stage directions without a word to me! The premiere is in ten days! You gave me your word that everything would be in order!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Ah, my dear colleague, I understand your frustration. It seems that there have been some unforeseen challenges in your absence. I assure you, I have done my best to uphold our agreement and ensure that everything is in order for the premiere.

Let us address these issues systematically. We shall prioritize the singers' entrances, ensuring that they are well-prepared for their roles. As for the missing second violin parts, I will take it upon myself to rectify this immediately. It is crucial that the orchestra has all the necessary components to bring the music to life.

Regarding the rewritten stage directions, it is indeed unfortunate that changes were made without your consultation. Let us review them together, and if necessary, we can discuss how best to incorporate your original vision back into the production.

I understand the pressure of the looming premiere, but let us approach these challenges with composure and professionalism. Together, we shall work diligently to bring our opera to the stage with the excellence it deserves.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Composure? Professionalism? Salieri, you speak as if this were a minor inconvenience! The second violin parts are not simply misplaced—they are gone! The copyist swears he never received them from you. And the stage directions—my staging—has been altered to something entirely different! This isn’t a matter of reviewing changes; this is sabotage of my work!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
My esteemed colleague, I share your distress over the gravity of the situation that has unfolded in your absence. I assure you that I take these matters with the utmost seriousness, as any deviation from the integrity of your work is indeed a severe concern.

The disappearance of the second violin parts is deeply troubling, and I can only offer my sincerest apologies for this oversight. I will personally investigate this matter and work swiftly to recreate the missing parts so that the orchestra can be complete once more.

As for the unauthorized alterations to your stage directions, I am deeply troubled by the notion of sabotage within our esteemed company. I vow to stand by your side in rectifying this issue and restoring your original vision. Together, we shall meticulously review the changes made and ensure that your staging is reinstated in its rightful form.

I understand the weight of this situation, and I am fully committed to resolving these challenges to the best of my abilities. Let us join forces to address these disruptions and reclaim the artistic integrity of your work. Your dedication and vision deserve to be honored, and I will spare no effort in assisting you to ensure the success of our upcoming premiere.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Investigate? Recreate? Salieri, we have ten days! The ink will hardly be dry before the first rehearsal! And you speak of "unauthorized alterations" as if you don’t know who did it! Who else has the authority to rewrite my staging but you? This is not some underling’s error—this is deliberate!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
My esteemed colleague, I understand the urgency of the situation, and I share your sense of alarm at the limited time we have before the premiere. I assure you that I did not intend to downplay the severity of the alterations or the impact they have on our production.

As for the changes to your staging, I must emphasize that I had no hand in such alterations. It goes against the very core of my principles as a composer and Kapellmeister to tamper with another artist's vision. I am as baffled by these unauthorized changes as you are, and I am committed to uncovering the truth behind this act of sabotage.

We must act swiftly and decisively to address these challenges before us. I will work diligently to assist in the recreation of the missing second violin parts and the restoration of your original stage directions. Together, we must focus our efforts on ensuring that our performers are adequately prepared and that your artistic vision is realized on stage.

Please believe me when I say that I am dedicated to resolving these issues and restoring the integrity of our production. Your trust in me is of the utmost importance, and I will do everything in my power to ensure that we deliver a premiere that honors your creative vision and our collective efforts as composers.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
Your principles? Your bafflement? Spare me, Salieri. I know how things work here. While I was away, you saw an opportunity to reshape my opera to your liking. Do not think I am blind to the whispers in the corridors, the sudden "improvements" that always seem to favor your own sensibilities. 

We will restore my staging, yes—but you will personally oversee every correction, and you will explain to the Emperor why his premiere is now in jeopardy because of your negligence. And as for the second violin parts—you will sit with the copyist tonight and rewrite every note from memory if you must. I will not have my name attached to a disaster.
